title: Research
text:
Research
My work uses a One Health approach to understand how infectious diseases persist and spread across human, animal and environmental systems. I combine field surveillance, spatial analysis and linked human and animal health data, and increasingly molecular and genomic methods, to strengthen disease detection and inform control.

title: Rabies Persistence in Southern Malawi
text:
Overview
Rabies continues to circulate in parts of Southern Malawi despite repeated mass dog vaccination. This research investigates the spatiotemporal drivers of that persistence by integrating dog vaccination, animal surveillance, human exposure and genomic data.
